strategy: Use the real Danone PPTX template as the source of truth. Select a semantic intent, copy the preferred layout or sample slide, then fill existing placeholders instead of recreating layout geometry from HTML. Layouts are chosen from ACTUAL sample slides in the template — not all 252 layouts have sample slides.

opening-cover.notes: Use for the first slide. Preserve the large Danone circle/photo geometry from the source layout.

contents.notes: Use for agenda pages. Keep item numbering and image treatment inherited from the template.

section-photo.notes: Use for section breaks and photography-led pages. Native image replacement is not implemented yet; route this intent through the HTML fallback path.

big-message.preferred_layout: Blue: Full White - Big Text / No Caps
fallback_layouts: Blue: Text w/ Large Image - Big Text
big-message.notes: Use for single takeaways. Prefer No Caps variants to avoid forced uppercase.

two-column.notes: Use for balanced argument or comparison pages.

three-column.notes: Use for scenario pages with three categories (pain points, data, products).

image-content.notes: Use when a real Danone/product/photo asset carries the page. Native image replacement is not implemented yet; route this intent through the HTML fallback path.

chart-or-table.notes: Use native PowerPoint charts/tables where possible so the output remains editable.

closing.notes: Use for thank-you and final action slides.
